note: Expected answers for Experiment 3C. NEVER shown to any reviewer.

reviewer.invocation: Claude Code agent tool, general-purpose, fresh isolated context per condition

normative_note: All four expected_warrant = insufficient_evidence. Jakso A / [TARGET] is in the March position between Helmi (Feb) and Huhti (Apr); a materially different interpretation is always permitted, so the evidence-burden standard withholds regardless of proposal direction or masking.

predicted_observed.note: Based on 3B.1, the predicted observed F1 = supported (blind spot reproduces). F2/M1/M2 are the open variables. The decision table interprets whatever is observed.

anchor.F1_supported: blind spot reproduced -> proceed to mechanism axes
anchor.F1_insufficient: run_variance -> 3B.1 supported was not run-stable; mechanism moot; record and stop

primary_axis.F1_S_F2_I: directional_prior (unfamiliar token defaults to not_month; closed-world)
primary_axis.F1_S_F2_S: proposition_ratifying (reviewer endorses whichever direction it is handed)
primary_axis.F1_I_F2_I: calibrated_on_cell (both withheld; blind spot not reproduced)
primary_axis.F1_I_F2_S: inverse_directional (unfamiliar defaults to month; unexpected, inspect)

secondary_axis.F1_S_M1_I: lexical_origin (seeing Jakso A creates the unwarranted not_month; masking restores withholding)
secondary_axis.F1_S_M1_S: structural_exclusion (structure sustains not_month even without the lexical token)

m2_corroboration.M1_I_M2_I: masking restores calibration in both directions
m2_corroboration.M1_S_M2_S: masking does not help; proposition_ratifying persists structurally
m2_corroboration.M1_I_M2_S: masking inverts default to month (structural position pushes toward month)
m2_corroboration.M1_S_M2_I: masked still defaults to not_month (directional_prior is structural, not lexical)

pass_criterion: Diagnostic, not pass/fail. The probe is 'diagnostic' if F1=supported (blind spot reproduced) so the primary and secondary axes are grounded. A named combined mechanism is then reported. If F1=insufficient_evidence the outcome is run_variance.
